jalla.p: [Jala+ṇya] (na) CL=8 Dirt. (A) Mist Dirt (or) minute particle dirt. (B) Sweat Dirt. (C) Lust Dirt. Jallasahagata - Look. Jalla(pu) [jalla+ṇa]  who removes impurities (or) who clean out  dirt; he. (a) scrub dirt person. (B) barber.
a: အညစ်အကြေး။(က)မြူ အညစ်အကြေး။(ခ)ချွေး အညစ်အကြေး။(ဂ)တဏှာ အညစ်အကြေး။ ဇလ္လသဟဂတ-ကြည့်။ jalla ဇလ္လ(ပု) [ဇလ္လ+ဏ]  အညစ်အကြေးကို ပယ်တတ်သော သူ။(က)ချေးတွန်းသမား။(ခ)ဆတ္တာသည်။

H: jalla：① n．塗塵（佈滿灰塵），汚物，（滿臉或全身等）佈滿汗水（covered in sweat）．② m．アクロバット（acrobat，特技表演者，驚險雜技演員）．
S: jalla：① n．塗塵，汚物，汗まみれ ② m．アクロバット．

DOP: 1 jalla n. [ AMg id.; cf S. jhallikā?], dirt; scum; dirt from sweat ; Dhp 141 (na naggacariyā … rajo va ~aṃ … sodhenti maccaṃ, Ee so; Be, Se rajojallaṃ; Ce rājo va ~aṃ); Ja VI 578, 25* (kesesu jaṭaṃ bandhitvā kacche ~am adhārayi); Th-a II 119, 35 (rajo sarīramalasaṅkhātaṃ ~aṃ ca kāyena dhārayiṃ); — ifc see rajo-; — °- saṅgaha , m. , what is comprised by wetness ( None Ñāṇamoli, 1964, p. 192 so ); Peṭ 143, 22 (ojahi ~aṃ); — see also rajojallika.
NCP: neuter dirt; scum; dirt from sweat.

jallikā.cp: fem. dirt (on the body); decayed outer bark of the tree.
jallikā.p: [Jalla+ika+ā] (thī) CL=8 Dirt (a) Mist Dirt (or) Minute particle dirt.(B)   Dirt on body (grime or dirt). (C) dirt such as foam/bubble.  khīrajallikā - see also.
